name: Planora
status: In internal testing. Free, and hosted for you.
lede: Plan together, decide less, do more — a mobile-first shared activity planner that turns group indecision into events worth remembering.
about: A shared activity planner for groups, for web, Android and iOS. Free, and in internal testing.
description: Planora is a mobile-first shared activity planner for groups: a shared backlog of ideas, a guided Organize wizard with date voting, events, reminders and feedback. Web, Android and iOS.
summary: Plan together. Decide less. Do more. A shared activity planner for friends, family, couples and teams — Web, Android and iOS.

stack.label: Backend
stack.value: Go + Fiber, Clean Architecture, REST API under /api/v1

stack.label: Database
stack.value: SQLite (pure-Go modernc.org/sqlite), WAL, foreign keys, auto-migrations

stack.label: Frontend
stack.value: Flutter, Material Design 3, light/dark, responsive — one codebase for Web (PWA), Android and iOS

home.line: Ideas for the group. In testing.
home.aria: {name}, a shared activity planner for groups
